name: Chinqua's House & part of the Factories, Canton, China. March 1st 1828
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A view of the trading bases known as 'factories' (or 'hongs') at Canton (Guangzhou), seen from the east: (right to left) the Swedish, (Austrian) Imperial, Paoushun, American 'factories'.
